signs.text: Your boss uses your first name when you come in, and it is the right one.
Your boss turns to you in front of everyone and asks what you think. Your boss listens to all of it.
Your boss moves a folder off the chair next to the one at the head of the table. It might be for you. It might be that the folder was finished.
Your boss nods in your direction when you sit down. It could be a greeting. It could be the slide.
Your boss says that you will be copied in. Nobody says on what.
Your boss is cheerful with the whole room. You are in the room.
Your boss refers to you as "our colleague here". It may be that the name has slipped your boss's mind.
You begin a sentence. Your boss finishes it, differently, and moves to the next slide.
Your boss asks you a question, then checks the answer with someone else while you are still giving it.
